title: Problem 1.20 — Justify the above arguments rigorously.
exact_target: Justify rigorously the product, sum-to-integral and saddle-point steps proposed for root-of-unity colored Jones asymptotics, including the $5_2$ example and the general hyperbolic-knot method.

sources.citation: ULAM. AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10400020 (AMR-103-0020). CC BY 4.0.

T. Ohtsuki (editor), \emph{Problems on invariants of knots and 3-manifolds}, Geometry \& Topology Monographs 4 (2002), pp. 377--572 (published 2004), item 1.20 and its surrounding definitions and remarks.
